notes:
v1.0.49 - Smarter install dialog (adapts to dependencies).

The install confirmation now adapts its actions to the item's real
dependency state: no deps -> a single "Install" button; missing deps ->
"Install with Dependencies (N)" plus "Install Only"; all deps already
installed -> "Install Only" as the only action, still listing which
dependency the item needs (marked "Already installed"). CurseForge keeps
its single Install button. Verified: tsc clean, build clean, smoke 12/12.
